name: You're Bluffing!
summary: Auction and bluffing trading game where players collect sets of animal cards for multiplied points.
rules_text: Shuffle 40 animal cards (10 sets of 4) face down. Sort money cards by value. Each player gets two 0s, four 10s, one 50 hidden. Remaining money pile face down. Animal cards are public when owned, money is secret. On your turn choose: 1) Auction: reveal top animal. Other players bid increasing amounts. Auctioneer does not bid but can, after winning bid, pay that amount to the winner to take the card himself. If no bids, auctioneer gets it free. If a bidder cannot pay, he shows money and is excluded and bidding restarts. 2) Cow Trade: if you and another player own animals from same set, you may offer a hidden money pile (may be zero or empty, bluff allowed) for a specific animal of theirs. Defender can accept and take your money and give the animal, or make a hidden counter-offer. Offers are swapped and counted silently. Higher offerer loses: he must give his animal but keeps opponent's money. If equal, proposer must re-offer; second tie, defender must give animal for free. Donkey card interrupts auction to deal extra money to all (50, then 100, 200, 500). When animal deck is empty, only trades are allowed. Players with only complete sets are skipped. Game ends when deck empty and no trades possible. Score is value of completed sets multiplied: 2 complete sets doubles total, 3 triples, etc. Money worthless.
rating_reason: Auction and bluff trade with sets, hidden money, clear strategy
